name: website-oxc
description: Vercel project root for https://oxc.tsrx.dev — builds the docs site from ../docs with a root base path

scripts.build: node ../scripts/fetch-docs-wasm.ts && cd .. && SITE_ORIGIN=https://oxc.tsrx.dev SITE_BASE=/ node docs/build.mjs && rm -rf website-oxc/dist && cp -R docs/dist website-oxc/dist
